Machine-Learning Prediction

cytoGateR authors

Source: vignettes/Machine_Learning_Prediction.qmd

1 Overview

Tree gating can identify high-confidence reference cells while leaving ambiguous cells unassigned. This vignette uses the stored core_group labels to train a weighted k-nearest-neighbour classifier and predict the remaining cells.

The example uses one complete image and reduced cross-validation settings to remain suitable for package checks.

library(cytoGateR)
data("cytoGateR_example", package = "cytoGateR")

image_ids <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(cytoGateR_example)$image_name
spe <- cytoGateR_example[, image_ids == image_ids[1L]]
table(SummarizedExperiment::colData(spe)$core_group)

      Bcell     BnTcell         CD4         CD8     Myeloid  Neutrophil
        236         337         227         206         108          12
Plasma_cell      Stroma        Treg       Tumor  Unassigned
         40          71         125          16        2985

2 Train a weighted kNN reference

Only cells with a known core_group label are used during reference cleaning. The "Unassigned" cells are retained for subsequent prediction.

knn_reference <- train_custom_knn(
  spe,
  label_col = "core_group",
  assay_name = "exprs",
  unknown_label = "Unassigned",
  features = c("CD3e", "CD20", "CD4", "CD8a"),
  cv_folds = 2,
  repeats = 1,
  agreement_thresh = 0.5,
  k = 3,
  method = "pearson",
  seed = 1,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

The returned object contains a cleaned reference and cross-validated probabilities for retained reference cells:

names(knn_reference)
[1] "spe"             "model"           "core_prob_mat"   "agreement_rates"
[5] "features_used"  
dim(knn_reference$model$reference_data)
[1] 782   4
table(knn_reference$model$reference_labels)

      Bcell     BnTcell         CD4         CD8     Myeloid  Neutrophil
        175         197         154         165          52           0
Plasma_cell      Stroma        Treg       Tumor
          6           7          24           2

3 Predict unassigned cells 

knn_prediction <- predict_unknown_with_knn(
  knn_reference$spe,
  knn_reference,
  assay_name = "exprs",
  label_col = "cleaned_core_label",
  out_col = "knn_label_filled",
  pred_col = "knn_pred",
  unknown_label = "Unassigned",
  threshold = 0.5,
  k = 3,
  dist_method = "pearson"
)
prediction_cd <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(knn_prediction$spe)
table(prediction_cd$knn_label_filled)

      Bcell     BnTcell         CD4         CD8     Myeloid Plasma_cell
        603        1369         861         502         564          66
     Stroma        Treg       Tumor  Unassigned
        106         131          59         102 
summary(prediction_cd$knn_confidence)
   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.     NAs
 0.3334  0.6670  1.0000  0.8771  1.0000  1.0000     782

4 Assemble the full probability matrix

train_custom_knn() returns probabilities for retained reference cells, while predict_unknown_with_knn() returns probabilities for predicted cells. They can be combined and aligned to the cells present in the updated object.

full_prob_mat <- rbind(
  knn_reference$core_prob_mat,
  knn_prediction$prob_mat
)
full_prob_mat <- full_prob_mat[colnames(knn_prediction$spe), , drop = FALSE]

dim(full_prob_mat)
[1] 4363   10
summary(rowSums(full_prob_mat))
   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.
      1       1       1       1       1       1

5 Quantify uncertainty

The uncertainty calculation combines probability-distribution measures with a sample-aware spatial-discordance score.

uncertainty <- calculate_uncertainty(
  full_prob_mat,
  knn_prediction$spe,
  sample_col = "sample_id",
  k_spatial = 3
)
head(uncertainty)
     cell_id   entropy gini_impurity margin_uncertainty spatial_discordance

12_5    12_5 0.2763651     0.4936561          0.6662051           1.0000000

7 Other classifiers

cytoGateR also provides random-forest and optional Torch-based deep-learning classifiers. They use the same core-label and unknown-cell workflow. The following production alternatives are not evaluated during vignette building.

rf_reference <- train_custom_randomforest(
  spe,
  label_col = "core_group",
  unknown_label = "Unassigned",
  cv_folds = 5,
  repeats = 10,
  seed = 1
)

dl_reference <- train_custom_dl(
  spe,
  label_col = "core_group",
  unknown_label = "Unassigned",
  epochs = 50,
  cv_folds = 5,
  repeats = 3,
  seed = 1
)
